description.zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, which is returned when you call the CreateRoom operation.

description.zh: 被设置为管理员的用户ID。
description.en: The ID of the user to be set as an administrator.

descriptions.zh: 房主不能被操作。单房间管理员数量上限5人。管理员拥有踢人、禁言/取消禁言、修改房间信息的权限。
descriptions.en: The room owner cannot be operated on. A maximum of 5 administrators can be set per room. Administrators have permissions to kick users, mute or unmute users, and modify room information.
